description: This file defines the ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions class, which contains configuration settings for resource-based placement of grains in an Orleans cluster. It includes properties for CPU, memory, activation count, and silo preferences, along with default values and validation logic. The class is used to tune how the placement algorithm prioritizes different resource considerations.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions
classes.description: Contains configuration settings for resource-optimized grain placement, including weights for CPU, memory, activation count, and preferences.

methods.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the options object with default values.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the resource placement options to ensure all weights are within the acceptable range.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks all weights to be within [0-100], throws exception if any are out of range.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation on configuration properties to ensure they are within [0-100].
